name: InvokeInferenceModelWebService
label: Invoke Inference Model Web Service
description: Invokes an AI model web service and returns the response text.

fields.name: SelectModel
fields.label: Select Model
fields.description: The name or identifier of the model to invoke (e.g., gpt-3.5-turbo).

fields.name: InputText
fields.label: Input Text
fields.description: The input text or prompt to send to the model.

fields.name: ModelApiKey
fields.label: Model API Key
fields.description: The API key required to authenticate with the model service.

fields.name: EndpointUrl
fields.label: Endpoint URL
fields.description: The URL of the web service endpoint (e.g., https://api.example.com/v1/completions).

fields.name: HttpMethod
fields.label: HTTP Method
fields.description: The HTTP method to use. Commonly POST for model inference.

selectOptions.label: GET
selectOptions.description: Retrieves data from the specified resource.

selectOptions.label: POST
selectOptions.description: Submits data to be processed to the specified resource.

selectOptions.label: PUT
selectOptions.description: Updates a current resource with new data.

selectOptions.label: PATCH
selectOptions.description: Applies partial modifications to a resource.

fields.name: RequestBody
fields.label: Request Body
fields.description: The request body to send in POST requests. Use {SelectModel} and {InputText} as placeholders.

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: Specifies the content type for the request body.

fields.name: AcceptHeader
fields.label: Accept Header
fields.description: Specifies the content type expected in the response.

fields.name: Headers
fields.label: Headers
fields.description: Custom HTTP headers to include in the request (e.g., specific model service headers).

fields.name: AIModelResult
fields.label: AIModelResult
fields.description: Returns the raw response from the web service as a string.

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.label: Response Code
fields.description: Returns the HTTP status code from the web service.
